ninja_boy.name: Ninja Boy
dialog: Look how high the Battle Tower goes! That's no accident.
The higher it stands, the harder it is to get to the top. It's a dare, built out of bricks.

black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: Every hall of the Frontier has a way in for two.
Bring a friend you trust and take it on side by side! Hah!

idol.name: Idol
dialog: Looking sweet and singing in tune won't keep an idol on the stage for ever.
So I'm studying battles. If I know my Pokémon, the people who love Pokémon will come to see me too!

ace_trainer_snow_f.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: The best trainers in the world come here, and every battle is all or nothing.
I've never been so frightened, and I've never been so wide awake.

twin.name: Twin
dialog: Do you know who matters most in the Battle Castle? A lady!
A real lady, I mean. Like a princess!

parasol_lady.name: Parasol Lady
dialog: What do I like best about being a trainer?
That whatever happens, my Pokémon are there beside me. That's all, and it's everything.

expert_m.name: Old Man
dialog: There's a story behind every Pokémon, if you take the time to hear it. Isn't that so, my dear?

expert_f.name: Old Lady
dialog: We've been side by side for a great many years, he and I, like a Pokémon and its trainer.
One day we shall be parted. Until that day I mean to treasure every hour, dearest.

waitress.name: Maid
dialog: People expect a great deal of a maid. Cooking, cleaning, the laundry...
And being a dab hand at training Pokémon on top of it all!

cowgirl.name: Cowgirl
dialog: To be strong is to be weak, and to be weak is to be strong. Somebody told me that when I was small.
I still haven't the faintest idea what it means.

roughneck.name: Roughneck
dialog: Some people love a battle right down to the soles of their boots.
Have a look round you. That's every last one of this lot.

pokefan_m.name: Pokéfan
dialog: How many years is it now since I met my first Pokémon? I've lost count.
And you? How long have you and yours been together?

collector.name: Collector
dialog: A trainer calls for a move without a moment's doubt, because the trainer trusts the Pokémon.
And the Pokémon gives the move all it has, to pay that trust back. Obvious, yes. It's still the whole of it.

gentleman.name: Gentleman
dialog: I go into every battle as though it were my last. To walk in ready to lose is unforgivable.
And yet nobody wins for ever. A good trainer takes the lesson and leaves the loss behind.

ace_trainer_m_2.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: The type! The moves! What it holds!
If you mean to be the best here, there's not one detail you can let slide.

picnicker.name: Picnicker
dialog: When I lose, the first thing I do is look for something to blame. Bad luck, or the other trainer, or my own Pokémon.
I know that's wrong. I won't get any better until I stop doing it.

pokemon_breeder_f.name: Pokémon Breeder
dialog: There are five halls in the Battle Frontier, and at each of them you can win your way up to its master.
They're called the Frontier Brains. Tough doesn't begin to cover it!

ace_trainer_m_1.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: It's nothing you haven't heard before, but there's no end to what there is to learn about Pokémon.

school_kid_m.name: School Kid
dialog: At the Battle Factory you fight with Pokémon they lend you, and you have to keep on winning with them.
It tests what you know, not what you own. Just the place for a student like me!

fisherman.name: Fisherman
dialog: The Battle Hall, that's the one for me.
In there even the Magikarp I pulled out of a pond has a chance of being number one!

tuber_m.name: Tuber
dialog: Life goes up and life goes down. I've got my rubber ring, so I just bob along on top.
